data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 冬季街头
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 冬季街头】冬日黄昏的寒风穿过街道，雪乃将格子围巾向上拉住，遮好口鼻。她穿着海军蓝牛角扣大衣，侧头望向落后半步的同行者，蓝色眼眸里透出克制的关切。路灯已亮，细雪落在围巾边缘。
data.action: 一手拉住格子围巾遮好口鼻，另一手放大衣口袋，侧头关切地看同行者
data.camera: cowboy shot, wrapping scarf in falling snow
data.promptProse: Yukino pulls the plaid scarf over her mouth and nose with one hand, keeping the other in her navy duffle-coat pocket as she turns concern toward her unseen companion. Dark tights and winter boots complete the warm silhouette. The cowboy view includes snowflakes on the collar and the street receding behind her. Newly lit lamps illuminate long black hair and scarf checks, while snow reflects cooler light onto the coat's shaded side.
